req.title: OpenAPI includes task schemas
req.statement: The system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-040 requires that GET /openapi.json documents TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas. Tests must verify: (1) positive — all three schema names appear in the OpenAPI spec components/schemas section with correct HTTP 200 status; (2) negative — schemas that should NOT be present (e.g. invented names) are absent, confirming the spec is not trivially permissive; (3) boundary — each schema contains the exact fields defined in schemas.py (title, description, completed for TaskCreate/TaskUpdate; id, created_at, updated_at for Task), catching mutations that drop or rename fields. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes, exact schema names as keys, and exact field names within each schema.

tests.name: test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable via 'from app.main import app'
GET /openapi.json is served by FastAPI automatically
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
Assert 'TaskCreate', 'TaskUpdate', and 'Task' are all keys in components/schemas
trace: R-TASK-040: system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    assert "TaskCreate" in schemas
    assert "TaskUpdate" in schemas
    assert "Task" in schemas

test_openapi_contains_all_three_task_schemas()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

    assert r.status_code == 200

    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]

tests.name: test_openapi_schema_count_includes_required_three
preconditions: OpenAPI spec is generated from the app's routes and schemas
actions: Assert count >= 3 (at minimum TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, Task must be present)
Assert each of the three required schema names is individually present
expected: All three required schemas present by exact name
trace: R-TASK-040: all three schemas must be documented; count >= 3 catches mutations that remove a schema entirely
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_schema_count_includes_required_three():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    assert len(schemas) >= 3
    required_names = {"TaskCreate", "TaskUpdate", "Task"}
    present = set(schemas.keys())
    missing = required_names - present
    assert missing == set(), f"Missing schemas: {missing}"

test_openapi_schema_count_includes_required_three()
